summary: Empery Digital Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a strategic partnership with Cardinal Power LLC (affiliated with Hunt Properties) to acquire powered land for AI/high-performance computing data centers. Empery contributed $2.9M initially with a $62.1M commitment, while TexStack (Cardinal subsidiary) contributed $2.5M. Empery holds 25% and TexStack 75% common units in the joint venture EMHU, LLC. TexStack manages capital calls and distributions. The filing creates a direct financial obligation via an irrevocable guarantee by Empery for subsidiary contributions. No transaction price, premium, or board recommendation is stated. Watch for property acquisition closing and capital call mechanics.
